# LILETTI

LILETTI is a minimal-luxury womenswear label that ships across Moldova, with all prices listed in Moldovan lei (MDL).

## Key links

- Storefront: https://liletti.delice.my
- Journal / Blog: https://liletti.delice.my/blog

## About

LILETTI designs minimal-luxury womenswear built around clean lines, considered materials, and pieces meant to last beyond a single season. The collection is sold online and shipped within Moldova, with pricing shown in Moldovan lei (MDL). The site is available in English, Russian, and Romanian.
